name: connector-hub
description: 服务器连接器统一管理：注册表 + Copilot 工具注册 + 健康检查面板

languageModelTools.name: lark_doc_create
languageModelTools.userDescription: 在飞书云空间创建新文档（支持 Markdown 内容）
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Create a new Lark (Feishu) document, optionally with Markdown content. Use ONLY for Lark online documents; do NOT use for local files. Returns document_id and url on success.

languageModelTools.name: lark_doc_update
languageModelTools.userDescription: 更新飞书文档：追加内容、替换文本或整体覆写
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Update an existing Lark document. Modes: append (add Markdown content at end), overwrite (replace ENTIRE document - destructive), str_replace (find/replace text). Use overwrite only when full replacement is intended.

languageModelTools.name: lark_doc_fetch
languageModelTools.userDescription: 读取飞书文档内容（Markdown 或 XML）
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Fetch content of a Lark document by URL or token. Returns document content as Markdown (default) or XML. Read-only, no confirmation needed.

languageModelTools.name: lark_doc_search
languageModelTools.userDescription: 按关键词搜索飞书文档/Wiki/表格
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Search Lark docs, Wiki and spreadsheet files by keyword. Returns matching files with tokens and URLs. Read-only.

languageModelTools.name: lark_md_create
languageModelTools.displayName: 创建飞书 Markdown 文件
languageModelTools.userDescription: 在飞书云盘创建原生 Markdown 文件
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Create a native Markdown file in Lark Drive (Drive-native .md, NOT a docx document). Best for plain Markdown knowledge notes. Returns file_token and url.

languageModelTools.name: lark_md_overwrite
languageModelTools.displayName: 覆写飞书 Markdown 文件
languageModelTools.userDescription: 覆写飞书云盘 Markdown 文件内容
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Overwrite content of an existing Drive-native Markdown file by file_token. Destructive: replaces entire content.

languageModelTools.name: lark_md_fetch
languageModelTools.displayName: 读取飞书 Markdown 文件
languageModelTools.userDescription: 读取飞书云盘 Markdown 文件内容
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Fetch content of a Drive-native Markdown file by file_token. Read-only.
